      - "airbyte-connector-test-harness/.gitattributes"
      - "airbyte-connector-test-harness/.gitmodules"
      - "airbyte-connector-test-harness/.dockerignore"

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r airbyte-connector-test-harness/requirements.txt

      - name: Run compatibility tests
        run: |
          python -m pytest airbyte-connector-test-harness/tests/ -v --tb=short -k "source"
